title: OpenFreeMap through our own address
text: Roads and water (T-4275): since 11-24 23:11 UTC, EasyPrivacy (on by default in uBlock Origin and Brave; NordVPN behaves the same) blocks OpenFreeMap's planet tiles on every site. Master now falls back to an address the rule misses, ready for the hotfix. The lasting fix is serving OpenFreeMap through our own address (a Cloudflare Worker at data.anita.garden/ofm/ with caching; OpenFreeMap's terms checked first), a server change. Set it up? I'd say yes. Also: 11 of your website's maps use OpenFreeMap (korearail, cityhistory, londonriders, flights, languagedots, nycriders, japanrail, religiondots, noritetsu, ancestrydotsna, ancestrydots) and may be blank behind the same rule.

title: Weekend solve
text: Weekend riders (T-4242, C:\Users\anita\projects\maps\trainworld\notes\T-4242.md): a weekend-only short-turn gets no weekend riders because weekend riders are the weekday solve scaled. The fix: where a city's weekend trains differ in a period, solve that period again on the weekend trains (nothing changes where they match). It reverses your calls "no second solve" (T-266) and "crowd them rather than lose them" (T-3521): cut weekend trains would now lose fares. Cost where weekends differ: loads about 45-55% longer on 3 workers (NYC 78-81 s to about 115-120 s), up to twice as long on 1 worker; about 7% more memory per worker. About 10-12 h. Build it? Your call; I lean yes since players see it, but the load cost is real.

title: Buy trains after the confirm
text: Edit speed (T-4272): a station on a running line's track can't be confirmed quickly today, because the game first works out whether you can afford the extra trains that headway lines sharing that track would need (369 ms on your Asia save). Proposal: confirm the station from its own checks, then buy those trains right after, letting cash dip below zero the way loans can. Then every station and delete is confirmed from local checks. OK? I'd say yes.
